Historical instream water temperature and discharge at WHYCHUS CR AT SISTERS, OR

Source: R/data.R
whychus_at_sisters_historical.Rd

Daily discharge data collected by the Oregon Water Resources Department (OWRD) at the WHYCHUS CR AT SISTERS, OR monitoring station (station 14076050) on the Whychus.

Usage

whychus_at_sisters_historical

Format

A data frame with 4122 rows and 10 columns:

station_nbr

Numeric. OWRD station number (14076050).

date

Date. Observation date, ranging from 2015-10-01 to 2026-04-14

value

Numeric.Discharge in cfs

published_status

Character. OWRD data publication status (e.g. "PVL" = provisional).

download_date

Character. Date and time the data were downloaded from OWRD.

variable

Character. Variable name as returned by OWRD API (e.g. "water temperature (c)", discharge (cfs)).

statistic

Character. Summary statistic: "max", "min", "mean".

location

Character. Station location name ("camp polk").

estimated

Character. Flag indicating whether the value was estimated. NA if not estimated.

revised

Logical. Flag indicating whether the value has been revised. NA if not revised.

Source

Oregon Water Resources Department Near Real-Time Hydrograph: https://apps.wrd.state.or.us/apps/sw/hydro_near_real_time/display_hydro_graph.aspx?station_nbr=14076050
